Host-owned Certara MCP tools

Source: R/mcp_host_tools.R
dot-certara_host_tools.Rd

The knowledge (KB), memory, and meta tools the host exposes itself, as a list of ellmer::tool() objects. Provider-specific tools are added separately by .mcp_provider_tools().

Usage

.certara_host_tools(groups = c("meta", "knowledge", "memory"))

Arguments

groups

Host tool groups to include: any of "meta", "knowledge", "memory" (default all). Launch profiles pass a subset.

Value

A list of ellmer ToolDef objects.
